desc: Analyze the pairing condition and prove the reduction: K pairs feasible iff 2*A[i] <= A[N-K+i] for all i in [0,K) (K smallest as tops, K largest as bottoms), with disjoint index ranges for K <= N//2.
Implement binary search over K in [0, N//2] with feasibility check 2*A[i] <= A[N-K+i]; read stdin and write stdout.
Verify correctness of the first-K/last-K predicate, monotonicity in K, K=0 handling, and duplicate handling via integer `<=`.
Run the implementation on Samples 1,2,3 — outputs 3, 0, 6 all PASSED; confirmed no floating point and no hardcoded sample input.
Confirm complexity is acceptable (O(N log N) ~ 5e6 ops at N=5e5); no need to switch to O(N) two-pointer.
